quotes.text: And that there are two Zions spoken of in the scriptures is evident from a careful perusal thereof. Of the Zion at Jerusalem it is said, (2 Samuel v. 7,) “ David took the stronghold of Zion, the same is the city of David.” 1 Chronicles xi, 4, 6, “And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were the inhabitants of the land. And the inhabitants of Jebus said to…

or the Ark of the Covenant in the days of Moses, containing the sacred records, was moved from place to place in a cart. And so sacred was that Ark, if a man stretched forth his hand to steady it, when the cart jostled, he was smitten, and died. And would to God that all who attempt to do the same in this day, figuratively speaking, might share the same fate. And they will share it sooner or…
